ValidationRule.description: Prevent users from converting leads to IMGAs. Excludes contacts already residing at an IMGA account.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISBLANK(Related_Contact__r.Id),
IsConverted,
upper(left( Company ,3)) = "IM_" ,
NOT(CONTAINS ( $Label.IM_Admin_Profiles , Owner_Details__r.Profile.Name ) )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Leads cannot be converted to IMGA Accounts.
